products.name: Albuterol (HFA Inhaler)
products.description: Albuterol inhalation is a prescription bronchodilator used to treat or prevent bronchospasm in patients with reversible airway disease and to help prevent exercise induced bronchospasm.

products.name: Amoxicillin (Capsule)
products.description: Amoxicillin is a prescription penicillin class antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections. It should only be used when a susceptible bacterial infection is confirmed or strongly suspected.

products.name: Azithromycin (Z-Pack) (Tablet)
products.description: Azithromycin is a prescription antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections. It should only be prescribed when a susceptible bacterial infection is confirmed or strongly suspected.

products.name: B12 (Injectable)
products.description: Vitamin B12 injection may be used to treat certain vitamin B12 deficiencies when clinically appropriate. A licensed provider should confirm the specific form of B12, your medical history, and whether injectable treatment is needed.

products.name: Benzonatate (Tessalon Perles) (Capsule)
products.description: Benzonatate is a prescription medication used for temporary relief of cough. The capsules must be swallowed whole and kept securely away from children.

products.name: Bi-Est / Progesterone Gentle Start
products.description: Bi Est and Progesterone Gentle Start is a provider guided hormone therapy option that uses a more gradual starting approach. A licensed provider will determine whether this option is appropriate based on your individual needs.

products.name: Bi-Est / Progesterone Standard Start
products.description: Bi Est and Progesterone Standard Start is a provider guided hormone therapy option for patients who may be appropriate for a standard starting approach. A licensed provider will determine whether this treatment fits your individual needs.

products.name: Bi-Estrogen (Topical Cream)
products.description: Bi Estrogen topical cream is a provider reviewed hormone therapy option that combines estrogen hormones in a topical formulation. Treatment is individualized and requires evaluation by a licensed provider.

products.name: Biotin / Finasteride / Minoxidil (Capsule)
products.description: Biotin / Finasteride / Minoxidil Capsule is a provider-reviewed hair support option designed to help support healthier-looking hair and address common factors linked with thinning hair. Finasteride is commonly used for male pattern hair loss, minoxidil may support hair growth, and biotin helps support normal hair and nail health. Results vary, and use must be reviewed and approved by a licensed provider.

products.name: Biotin / Minoxidil (Capsule)
products.description: A compounded oral combination of finasteride, minoxidil, and biotin that may be considered for selected patients with hair loss. A licensed provider should review the risks of each ingredient before prescribing.

products.name: Bremelanotide (Nasal Spray)
products.description: Bremelanotide nasal spray is a compounded prescription formulation. FDA approved bremelanotide is available as a subcutaneous injection for a specific type of low sexual desire in certain premenopausal women, but the nasal spray formulation is not FDA approved.

products.name: DHEA (Capsule)
products.description: DHEA is a hormone support option that may be considered when clinically appropriate. A licensed provider will review your health history, symptoms, medications, and treatment goals to determine whether it is suitable for you.

products.name: DHEA E4M (Slow Release Capsule)
products.description: DHEA E4M is a slow release hormone support capsule that may be considered after provider evaluation. A licensed provider will review your health history, symptoms, medications, and treatment goals before recommending treatment.

products.name: Estradiol (Topical Cream)
products.description: Estradiol topical cream is a prescription estrogen therapy option that may be considered for eligible patients experiencing hormone related changes. A licensed provider will review your symptoms, health history, and treatment goals before prescribing.

products.name: Finasteride (Tablet)
products.description: Finasteride is an FDA approved prescription tablet for male pattern hair loss in men. It works by reducing DHT, a hormone involved in this type of hair loss.

products.name: Finasteride / Minoxidil (Foam)
products.description: A compounded topical combination of finasteride and minoxidil that may be considered for certain patients with pattern hair loss. The topical combination itself is not FDA approved.

products.name: Fluocinolone / Minoxidil / Tretinoin / Biotin / Vitamin E (Topical Solution)
products.description: A compounded topical formula that combines minoxidil with additional ingredients that may be selected for individual scalp or hair concerns. A licensed provider will determine whether this combination is appropriate for you.

products.name: Fluticasone (Steroid Inhaler)
products.description: Fluticasone propionate nasal spray is a corticosteroid used to manage certain nasal symptoms. A licensed provider can determine whether this formulation is appropriate based on your symptoms and health history.

products.name: Glutathione (Capsule)
products.description: Glutathione is a naturally occurring substance in the body. An oral compounded glutathione capsule is not an FDA approved treatment for general wellness, detoxification, immunity, skin improvement, or anti aging.

products.name: Glutathione (Injectable)
products.description: Glutathione injectable is a compounded medication that is not FDA approved. FDA has reported serious safety concerns involving contaminated compounded glutathione injections, so treatment requires careful provider and pharmacy oversight.

products.name: Glutathione (Nasal Spray)
products.description: Glutathione nasal spray is a compounded formulation that may be considered after provider evaluation. It is not an FDA approved drug product, and wellness benefits have not been established by FDA.

products.name: Glutathione / NAD+ / Sermorelin (Injectable)
products.description: A compounded combination of glutathione, NAD+, and sermorelin that requires individualized provider review. This combination is not an FDA approved drug product.

products.name: Glutathione / NAD+ / Sermorelin / B12 (Injectable)
products.description: A compounded combination containing glutathione, NAD+, sermorelin, and vitamin B12. The combination itself is not FDA approved, and a licensed provider should determine whether its ingredients and formulation are appropriate for you.

products.name: Ibuprofen (Tablet)
products.description: Ibuprofen is an NSAID used to relieve pain and inflammation in appropriate patients. Prescription use should be based on individual medical history, symptoms, and potential risks.

products.name: Keflex Cephalexin (Capsule)
products.description: Cephalexin is a prescription cephalosporin antibiotic used for certain bacterial infections. It should only be used when the infection is confirmed or strongly suspected to be caused by susceptible bacteria.

products.name: Ketoconazole / Latanoprost / Finasteride / GHK-Cu
products.description: A compounded topical hair formula that combines several ingredients with different roles in scalp and hair care. A licensed provider will review your history and treatment goals to determine whether this combination is appropriate for you.

products.name: Lidocaine Viscous (Oral Solution)
products.description: Lidocaine viscous is a prescription local anesthetic used to temporarily numb painful or irritated areas of the mouth and throat. It should be used exactly as directed because excessive exposure can cause serious harm.

products.name: Liraglutide (Injectable)
products.description: Liraglutide is a prescription injectable medication that works with GLP 1 pathways involved in appetite and blood sugar regulation. A licensed provider will review your health history and treatment goals to determine whether it is an appropriate option for you.

products.name: Low Dose Naltrexone (LDN)
products.description: Low dose naltrexone uses naltrexone differently from its FDA approved dosing and indications. Its use for general wellness or other nonapproved conditions is off label and requires evaluation by a licensed provider.

products.name: Methylene Blue (Capsule)
products.description: Methylene blue capsule is a compounded oral formulation that is not FDA approved. FDA approved methylene blue is an intravenous medication used for acquired methemoglobinemia, not for general wellness or cognitive enhancement.

products.name: Methylprednisolone (Dose Pack)
products.description: Methylprednisolone is a prescription corticosteroid used for certain inflammatory, allergic, and immune related conditions. A licensed provider will determine whether treatment is appropriate for your symptoms and medical history.

products.name: Minoxidil / Finasteride (Topical Liquid Solution)
products.description: A compounded topical combination of minoxidil and finasteride that may be considered for certain patients with pattern hair loss. A licensed provider will review your health history and potential risks before prescribing.

products.name: Minoxidil / Ketoconazole / Finasteride (Hair Foam)
products.description: A compounded topical foam combining minoxidil, ketoconazole, and finasteride for selected patients with hair or scalp concerns. A licensed provider should determine whether this combination is appropriate.

products.name: Minoxidil / Ketoconazole / Latanoprost / Finasteride / GHK-Cu (Hair Foam)
products.description: A compounded topical foam containing several ingredients that may be considered as part of an individualized hair and scalp treatment plan. The finished combination is not FDA approved.

products.name: Mounjaro® (Prefilled Syringe)
products.description: Mounjaro Prefilled Syringe (tirzepatide) is a prescription medication indicated for adults with type 2 diabetes to improve blood sugar control when used along with diet and exercise. This product must be used under the supervision of a licensed healthcare provider. It is not intended for self-diagnosis or as a substitute for professional medical advice. Individual results and tolerability may vary.

products.name: NAD+ (Injectable)
products.description: NAD+ injectable is a compounded medication that is not FDA approved. A licensed provider should review its potential risks and the limited evidence supporting commonly promoted wellness uses before treatment.

products.name: NAD+ (Nasal Spray)
products.description: NAD+ nasal spray is a compounded formulation that may be considered only after review by a licensed provider. It is not an FDA approved drug product, and benefits for energy, cognition, metabolism, or healthy aging have not been established by FDA.

products.name: Naproxen (Tablet)
products.description: Naproxen is a nonsteroidal anti inflammatory medication used to manage pain and inflammation in certain conditions. A provider should review your medical history and other medications before prescribing.

products.name: Ozempic® (Prefilled Syringe)
products.description: Ozempic® (semaglutide) is a prescription GLP-1 medication used along with diet and exercise to help improve blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes. Treatment requires evaluation and prescribing by a licensed clinician.

products.name: PT-141 (Injectable)
products.description: PT 141 is another name used for bremelanotide. FDA approved bremelanotide injection exists for a specific form of low sexual desire in certain premenopausal women, but a compounded PT 141 injectable is not the FDA approved Vyleesi product.

products.name: Penicillin (Tablet)
products.description: Penicillin V is a prescription antibiotic used for certain infections caused by susceptible bacteria. It should only be prescribed when a bacterial infection is confirmed or strongly suspected.

products.name: Prednisone (Tablet)
products.description: Prednisone is a prescription corticosteroid used to reduce inflammation and modify immune responses in a variety of medical conditions. Treatment should be individualized by a licensed provider.

products.name: Progesterone (Topical Cream)
products.description: Progesterone topical cream is a prescription hormone therapy option that may be considered when clinically appropriate. A licensed provider will review your health history, symptoms, and treatment goals to determine whether it is right for you.

products.name: Semaglutide (Injectable)
products.description: Semaglutide is a prescription injectable medication that may be considered for eligible patients as part of a provider guided weight management plan. A licensed provider will review your health history and goals to determine whether it is appropriate for you.

products.name: Semaglutide (ODT)
products.description: Semaglutide ODT is a prescription weight management option that dissolves in the mouth and may be considered for patients who prefer a non injectable treatment. A licensed provider will review your health history and goals to determine whether it is appropriate for you.

products.name: Sildenafil (Tablet)
products.description: Sildenafil is an FDA approved prescription medication for erectile dysfunction. It helps improve erectile response during sexual stimulation and should be used after a licensed provider reviews your health history and medications.

products.name: Spironolactone (Capsule)
products.description: Spironolactone is an FDA approved prescription medication for several cardiovascular and fluid related conditions. Its use for hair loss is off label and should be considered only after evaluation by a licensed provider.

products.name: Tadalafil (Tablets)
products.description: Tadalafil is an FDA approved prescription medication for erectile dysfunction. It supports erectile response during sexual stimulation and can be prescribed for either as needed or daily use depending on the patient.

products.name: Tadalafil (Troche)
products.description: Tadalafil troche is a compounded oral formulation that may be considered for erectile dysfunction after provider evaluation. FDA approved tadalafil is available as tablets, but the troche formulation itself is not FDA approved.

products.name: Tamiflu (Oseltamivir) (Capsule)
products.description: Oseltamivir is an antiviral prescription medication used to treat or help prevent influenza A and B in eligible patients. Treatment is most appropriate when started soon after flu symptoms begin.

products.name: Tirzepatide (Injectable)
products.description: Tirzepatide is a prescription injectable medication that may be considered as part of a provider guided weight management plan. A licensed provider will review your health history, goals, and current medications to determine whether treatment is appropriate for you.

products.name: Vardenafil (Capsule)
products.description: Vardenafil is FDA approved in certain tablet formulations for erectile dysfunction. A compounded vardenafil capsule is a different dosage form and is not an FDA approved finished drug product.

products.name: Wegovy® (Prefilled Syringe)
products.description: Wegovy® (semaglutide) is a prescription GLP-1 medication used with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity to help eligible adults lose excess weight and maintain weight reduction long term.

products.name: Zanamivir (Rotadisk Inhaler)
products.description: Zanamivir is an antiviral inhalation medication used for certain cases of influenza A and B. A licensed provider will determine whether treatment or prevention is appropriate based on your symptoms, health history, and timing of exposure.

products.name: Zepbound® (Prefilled Syringe)
products.description: Zepbound (tirzepatide) is a prescription once-weekly injection indicated as an adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity for chronic weight management in adults who meet BMI criteria, under medical supervision.
